info.name: Coach Devanshi Doshi - API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Coach Devanshi Doshi app API.
Folders 1-3: signup, mobile & email OTP login, social login, forgot & reset password (the verify requests store auth_token).
Folders 4+: profile, home, onboarding chapters & consent, pathways & protocols, plan & renewal, tracking, calendar, progress, health sync, notifications and coach chat.

All responses use {success, message, data}; validation errors return HTTP 200 with success=false. Running the whole collection top to bottom works with a master test mobile number (static OTP 123456).

request.description: Signup new user. Mobile and phone_code are required. Email is optional. Generates OTP and sends to mobile (and email if provided).
Verifies mobile OTP for signup. Marks is_signup = true and returns Passport access token.
Resends a fresh OTP to the user's mobile number (and email if linked).
Initiates mobile OTP login. Generates OTP, saves it in database, and sends to the mobile number.
Initiates email OTP login. Generates OTP, saves it in database, and sends it via email.
Verifies mobile OTP, clears OTP in DB, and returns user details with Passport authToken.
Verifies email OTP, clears OTP in DB, marks email_verified_at, and returns user details with Passport authToken.
Password login for registered users.
Authenticates or signs up users via social login providers (Google, Apple, Facebook).
Requests forgot password OTP sent to email.
Requests forgot password OTP sent to mobile.
Verifies forgot password OTP and returns auth token for reset password.
Resets the user password using Bearer authentication token obtained from verify-forgot-otp.

item.name: 6. Onboarding (6 chapters + consent)
item.description: Forms are config driven (config/onboarding.php). GET a chapter for `fields` (key, label, type, required, required_if, min/max, options) and saved `answers`. Master-backed option values are onboarding_masters uuids; the Get Chapter requests store the first option of each field as {{opt_<key>}}. Send answers under `answers`; add `save_as_draft: true` to save without required checks ("Pause anytime").

request.description: Chapter list with status (pending / in_progress / completed), progress count, consent items, selected pathway and protocol status.
Raw option lists grouped by category; chapter=1..6 filters.
Field definitions + answers. Chapter 1 answers are prefilled from the profile when empty.

item.description: Plans are assigned by the coach in the admin panel. Renewal is coach assisted (no payment).
